To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IL-6 and neuronal NOS are expressed in different populations of hypothalamic cells, and that the expression of IL-6 in CRF cells is restricted to a specific subset of these cells.
the hypothalamic neurons that synthesize corticotropin releasing factor (CRF), arginin-vaso-pressin (AVP) and interleukine 6 (IL- 6) are different.
the expression pattern of IL-6 and nitric oxide synthase is different in the hypothalamic cells of the corticotropin releasing factor system and in the arginin vasopressin cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the expression of the cytokine IL-6 and the enzyme NOS in hypothalamic CRF and AVPR1a cells.
the expression of the cytokine interleukin- 6 in the hypothalamo-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis.
the expression of IL-6 and nitric oxide synthase within the hypothalamic vasopressin and corticotrophin-releaser factor (CRF)-containing systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NOS and IL6 are not expressed in the same neurons in the hypothalamo-pituitary axis, and that they may be involved in the regulation of different functions.
IL-6 and NO are involved in a complex and integrated regulatory mechanism in the hypothalamo-pituitary axis.
NOS and IL 6 are expressed by different cell types in the CRF and AV P systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NOS is expressed by AVP and CRF cells, and that IL-6 is expressed only in a subset of AVP cells.

the expression of IL-6 and/or NOS in AVP and/or CRF cells is not restricted to a specific hypothalamic region and that the expression pattern of IL-6, NOS, AVP and CRF in hypothalamic neurons may vary according to their phenotype.
NOS, IL-6, and CRF are expressed in different cell populations, whereas AVP is coexpressed with IL-6 and with NOS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NOS is not a general marker of CRF and AVPR1a cells.
the hypothalamic CRF system is composed of two distinct populations of cells.
the expression of IL-6 and NO synthase in the hypothalamic CRF and AV systems suggests that IL-6 and/or NO may be involved in the regulation of CRF and AV secretion.
